senses.gloss:
रध् रन्ध् र॑ध्यति pp. रद्ध॑ be or make subject
to (dat.);
 harass, pain. C. रन्ध॑यति (˚ते) = S. trans. I.
(रारन्धि॑) subdue. — नि give into the power of (dat.).

रध्र॑ a. wretched, poor;
 a miser.

रा॑धस् n. favour, gracious gift, blessing, liberality,
munificence.

†राधस्पति^1 m. lord of gifts.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
राधाकान्त m. the beloved of Rādhā i.e. Kṛṣṇa.
राधेय m. metron. of Karna and Bhīṣma.
राधोदे॑य n. bestowing wealth or showing favour.
